slug: 2017-01-01 AU - Report on the Status of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in Africa
note: A continental report on the October 2016 APAI-CRVS self-report survey: Swaziland appears only in the annex's score bands (digitisation of the civil registration system 65-79%; legal framework, infrastructure and registration process 50-64%; planning 65-79%; overall 50-64%), with no named system and no statement of how or in how many offices its records are captured.
